user.title: Home Climate Control
user.description: Connect a **Home Climate System** device as the boiler gateway (ESP32/ESP8266), or pick **Demo** to explore without hardware. Rooms (TRV + temperature) are configured next.

demo.title: Demo
demo.description: Creates a simulated boiler with outdoor temperature, flame/modulation, and two rooms (Living Room + Bedroom). No MQTT or hardware required. Open the **Home Climate** sidebar after setup.

zone.title: Add a room
zone.description: Rooms already added: {zone_count}. A room is: **TRV** + optional **wall temperature sensor** + optional **window/door sensors**. Open window/door pauses heating for that room. No external temp → TRV temperature is used. The ESP gateway is boiler-only, not part of a room.

data.name: Room name
data.add_another: Add another room after this one

discovery.title: New Home Climate System gateway found
discovery.description: Board **{node}** announced itself on MQTT. Confirm to adopt it as the boiler gateway — rooms are configured on the next screen.

error.node_required: Enter the HCS gateway node id (shown on the device web UI).
error.trv_required: Select a TRV climate entity for this room.

data.learn_setbacks: Learn smart night/Away setbacks per room

data_description.auto_tune_curve: Watches room comfort and slowly adjusts the curve coefficient to burn less gas. The learned value persists across restarts.
data_description.learn_setbacks: Measures how fast each room recovers after away/eco periods and sizes future setbacks so mornings are warm without wasteful catch-up burns.
data_description.outdoor_sensor: Used when the boiler outdoor reading is missing or older than 30 minutes. Pick a HA temperature sensor or weather entity.
data_description.boiler_min_modulation: Lowest continuous fire the boiler can hold (nameplate). Below this, HCC duty-cycles CH instead of short-cycling.
data_description.duty_cycle_enabled: When demand is below min modulation, PWM the burner with long on/off slices (default 10 min floors) instead of continuous low fire.
data_description.rated_heat_input_kw: The MAXIMUM 'central heating input' from the boiler's nameplate (heat input, not output). Used to convert modulation % into kW.
data_description.min_heat_input_kw: Lowest firing rate from the nameplate range (e.g. 24 kW max / 4 kW min). Improves accuracy at low fire; leave 0 for simple proportional math.
data_description.nomod_duty_factor: For boilers that never report modulation: estimated average burner output fraction while the flame is on. 0.6 suits most on/off boilers.
data_description.gas_calibration: Multiply estimates so they match your gas meter exactly (e.g. meter shows 0.95x of ours -> set 0.95). Compare after a full day of heating.
data_description.gas_price_per_kwh: Adds a cost-per-day estimate to the panel. Leave empty to skip.
